title: SRAV IPO News - Farmland owner Source Agriventures files for a $15 million IPO
content: Source Agriventures owns US farmland and leases it to tenant farmers, and plans to add revenue from renewable energy, data center and AgTech projects on its land. The company's sole property is a 158-acre farm in Macon County, Illinois, which is leased to a tenant farmer and to RWE Clean Energy for the development of a wind energy project. The company plans to acquire additional farms in the Midwest and Sun Belt, initially at $2 million to $10 million each, and to lease portions of them to [...] portions of them to renewable energy developers and, eventually, AI data center operators. The company currently generates minimal revenue and is unprofitable. [...] Source Agriventures, which seeks to own farmland to lease for agriculture and energy purposes, filed on Monday with the SEC to raise up to $15 million in an initial public offering.

title: New Source Energy Partners files for IPO of up to $106 mln | Reuters
content:
Dec 31 (Reuters) - New Source Energy Partners LP on Monday filed with U.S. regulators to raise up to $106.3 million in an initial public offering of its common units.

The company named Baird, Stifel Nicolaus Weisel, BMO Capital Markets and Oppenheimer & Co as lead underwriters for the offering. ()

Sign up here.

New Source Energy Partners was formed in October by New Source Energy Corp to own and acquire oil and natural gas properties in the United States. [...] New Source Energy Partners said it intends to list its common units on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "NSLP."

The filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission did not reveal how many units the company planned to sell or their expected price.

The amount of money a company says it plans to raise in its first IPO filing is used to calculate registration fees. The final size of the IPO could be different.
